additional_info.subject: Translation
additional_info.body: Error since December 11, 2024 The backend charge cloud provides the following information about completed LVs. Reason for the anomaly: "No signed start measurement value compliant with calibration law was transmitted." There is no current fault report from the charging stations. What could be the cause of the error?
